QuestInfo.name: Mu Lung Medicine
QuestInfo.0: What does Kiridu know about treating Cygnus's illness? Talk to Kiridu.
QuestInfo.1: Go to Mu Lung's Mr. Do to get medicine.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to go to Mu Lung.)#k
QuestInfo.2: Medicine itself isn't that hard to make, it's the ingredients... You might have to get those ingredients again.

0.0: I hear Mu Lung's medicine works best for this kind of illness. Are you ready to go?

yes.0: There is a pharmacist in Mu Lung named Mr. Do. I already let him know you're coming.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to go see Mr. Do in Mu Lung.)#k\r\n

no.0: Think about this. What would Cygnus do? Don't you think she'd try HER best to get YOU to feel better?

1.0: Hello! I've been waiting for you.\r\n#L0##bAre you Mr. Do, Mu Lung's top pharmacist?#l\n#k
1.1: What, Mu Lung's best? Kid, I'm the best in all of Maple World. Get it straight!\r\n#L0##bRight, sure. Look, I need some medicine. It's very urgent.#l\n#k
1.2: Yes, yes, it always is. But you came from Ereve... Who in Ereve needs such cure? \r\n#L0##b(You can't go around telling people about the Empress... What to do?)#l\n#k
1.3:
I know for a fact that there are no children in Ereve that need this medicine... Why so suddenly? Why so urgent? Is somebody important weak in health?
#L0##bActually I need it for myself.#l
#L1#There's nobody with weak health... It's just in case.#l
#L2#None of your business.#l
#k
1.4: Hm... Really? Is that so... Fine, I'll make it for you.

3.0: You don't show any symptoms. I AM a doctor, if you recall.

npc.0: Mu Lung's medicine is the best for this kind of illness. Mr. Do will get you what we need. \r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to go to Mu Lung.)#k
